description: Na₃MgCo₂SbO₆ crystallizes in the triclinic P1 space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.84 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.83 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted NaO₄ trigonal pyramids that share  a cornercorner with one CoO₄ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent MgO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one CoO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.24-2.53 Å. Mg is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted MgO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent CoO₄ tetrahedra and corners with two equivalent NaO₄ trigonal pyramids. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 1.95-2.07 Å. There are two inequivalent Co sites. In the first Co site, Co is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted CoO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent MgO₄ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaO₄ trigonal pyramid, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₄ trigonal pyramid. There are a spread of Co-O bond distances ranging from 1.98-2.16 Å. In the second Co site, Co is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of Co-O bond distances ranging from 1.84-2.00 Å. Sb is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of Sb-O bond distances ranging from 1.99-2.05 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Mg, and one Co atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Mg, and one Co atom. In the third O site, O is bonded to three Na, one Co, and one Sb atom to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ONa₃CoSb trigonal bipyramids. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Mg, one Co, and one Sb atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to one Na, one Mg, one Co, and one Sb atom to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ONaMgCoSb trigonal pyramids. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a see-saw-like geometry to two Na and two Co atoms.
